The reflections on the curved metal blades are slightly inconsistent. Some areas show sharp highlights while adjacent areas blur into the background color without clear environmental mapping, suggesting minor texture synthesis issues.

The vertical stalks connecting the moldboards to the main red frame are thin and slightly wavy. The exact mechanical connection point is somewhat ambiguous and lacks the crisp bolt/weld details expected in a real photograph, appearing slightly 'melted' or soft.
